name: @triiiceratops/app-examples
description: Framework consumer examples published inside the documentation version directory. A private workspace application that consumes the viewer only through its published entrypoints; never published.
author: David Flood

scripts.build: vite build && pnpm build:static && pnpm build:bundles
scripts.build:static: rm -rf dist/examples/web-component dist/examples/plain-html && mkdir -p dist/examples && cp -r src/web-component dist/examples/web-component && cp -r src/plain-html dist/examples/plain-html
scripts.build:bundles: rm -rf dist/dist && cp -rL node_modules/triiiceratops/dist dist/dist && mkdir -p dist/dist/plugin-av && cp -rL node_modules/@triiiceratops/plugin-av/dist/. dist/dist/plugin-av/
